AyudaGrow / ExploreFollow-up & reminders

A good conversation deserves a next step.

Keep quotations, enquiries and appointments moving with clear ownership, timely reminders and a shared view of what needs attention.

From memory to a repeatable process

See what’s due.
Know who owns it.

A reminder is useful when it is connected to the customer, the last conversation and the action needed. Agree the timing and conditions, then make the next step visible to the right person.

Assign an owner and due date

Give the enquiry or quote a responsible person and a meaningful next action. Make the handoff explicit.

Follow the stage of the sale

Different situations need different timing. A fresh enquiry, a proposal awaiting review and an existing customer need different follow-through.

Stop when the situation changes

Review the configured stop conditions when a customer replies, books, declines or opts out, so messages remain relevant.

Keep the team informed

Show tasks, opportunity stages and conversation history together. AI can assist with a draft; a person can handle the decision.

Built around an agreed setup.

Illustrative workflow. Customer-facing messages require the right permissions, approved copy and channel rules. Internal reminders and customer messages are different actions; both need an agreed configuration.
